lines.1: 「Let's pick a girl whose name makes her sound quiet and cute, and like she'd do anything her seniors told her.」
lines.2: 「Cute and willing to do anything...? What would that even sound like?」
lines.3: 「First, she ends every sentence with '-mon.' Then whenever she messes up, she giggles 'Ehehe' and sticks out her tongue.」
lines.4: 「Is she some kind of monster from Chiba?」
lines.7: 「Senpai, Senpai! I bought you some juice!」
lines.8: 「Senpai, Senpai! I finished all your work for you!」
lines.16: 「This is what happens when all you read is that kind of manga. It rots your imagination.」
lines.17: 「And why am I the one you're using for the impression?!」
lines.18: 「That's because this boy's imagination is so pitiful, you're the only girl at school he can picture clearly.」
lines.21: 「Hey, I found a funny name on the roster. How about this one? Ushiko Hokkaido, handicrafts club.」
lines.22: 「Ooh, nice. She sounds huge. Bet her chest is pure Holstein.」
lines.25: 「The Tsushima family certainly is full of energy.」
lines.26: 「Miss Inori, you have cream on your cheek.」
lines.27: 「Yoppi, I trained you to lick it off at times like this, remember?」
